title: Ultrafast combustion synthesis of nickel-based self-supporting electrocatalysts for high current density oxygen evolution reaction
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6SE00493H, Paper
Tuzhi Xiong, Rong Bian, Chenchen Duan, Yao He, Yuqiang Tao
A one-step combustion method completed within seconds by simply igniting Fe-solution-soaked nickel foam in air. It sustains 800 mA cm−2 for 145 hours with negligible degradation, suitable for industrial-scale operation.
